subject.title: refactor: separate external conversations from local sessions

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these first-class conversation tools and the v11 persisted conversation-delivery model as the permanent core abstraction for external addressing?
rationale: The PR creates new model-facing tools, Gateway protocol methods, plugin delivery semantics, generated client APIs, and persistent database state; tests can verify implementation mechanics but cannot decide whether this is the desired long-term product contract.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Accept the proposed core abstraction once upgrade behavior and a real Reef send/turn/restart scenario are demonstrated on the exact head.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and reduce the PR to the minimum generic seam needed before committing to all three tools and durable delivery state.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Close or defer the implementation if external addressing should remain through the existing message tool and transport-specific targets.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed core abstraction once upgrade behavior and a real Reef send/turn/restart scenario are demonstrated on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked design issue is assigned to steipete and the supplied context identifies them as the sponsor of the cross-cutting implementation.
